AiM 1.0.7

Open the AiM.exe beside the Application Files and Documents folders. Keep all three together.
Drop bill PDFs and their amendment instructions on the homepage.
The bill version to mark and its amendments are the only required files.
Choose an output folder once; it is remembered and remains changeable.
Marked PDFs are saved automatically when the files finish loading.
Output: AB [Bill Number] [Month Day] AMENDS IN.pdf (SB is also supported).
Click an issue to open its original amendment PDF and highlighted instruction.
Successful marks may be saved with unresolved amendments clearly reported.
Yellow margin numbers and boxed numbers identify amendment locations.
Above/below-line arrows need only the referenced printed margin number.
Blue arrows mark insertions; red lines mark strikes; plain blue lines mark
strike-and-insert instructions without arrowheads. Original PDFs stay unchanged.
Existing outputs are skipped. PDF reading, OCR and markup run locally.
Documents/PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json records every packaged file except itself.
See Documents/README.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for scope and notices.
title: AiM 1.0.7
notes:
Cleaner portable Windows package and the actual AiM application icon.

- The top level contains only AiM.exe, Application Files and Documents.
- The AiM launcher has the chosen icon embedded for File Explorer, including all seven 16–256 pixel sizes.
- Electron and its support files stay together in Application Files. Instructions, README, notices and the package manifest are in Documents.
- The launcher forwards arguments and uses the correct application directory, without a console or installer.
- Existing UI, output-folder preferences, batch processing and PDF marks remain unchanged.

All 185 source tests passed. The actual packaged Windows app passed the complete batch/folder/retry/cancel/cache/error/OCR regression through the top-level launcher. Six output PDFs matched the previous approved bytes exactly, and all 355 package files remained unchanged. All seven embedded icon images matched the approved ICO bytes exactly. A separate test launched and exported PDFs from the reorganized downloaded copy at its original location.

Extract the complete ZIP and open AiM/AiM.exe. Keep AiM.exe, Application Files and Documents together. This Windows launcher uses the .NET Framework included with supported Windows 10/11 systems; no developer SDK is required. Publication requires exact reconstruction of the tested ZIP and manifest.
